subject: Discovery recap: BrightCart embeddings & reranking (index size, latency, next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lin <emma.lin@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: BrightCart embeddings & reranking (index size, latency, next steps)

Hi Emma \u001F thanks again for the chat today. Quick recap from my side to make sure we captured the key points and align on next steps. Please reply with any corrections or additions.

What we heard (pain & goals)
- Goal: improve search relevance and product discovery by adding a reranking layer over current retrieval; primary KPI is 10% uplift in add-to-cart from search-driven sessions.
- Pain: current retrieval gives noisy results for long-tail SKUs; business sees search->cart conversion drop by 18% for assisted queries.
- Success criteria: precision@10 / recall@10 improvement benchmarked against current system, and end-to-end 95th-pt latency for rerank <= 100ms (target 50ms if possible).

Current stack and index scale (what you told us)
- Retriever: ElasticSearch for initial candidate retrieval.
- Vector DB: Pinecone (production), ~8\u201312M vectors, average vector dim 1536. Ingest cadence: nightly full reindex + near-real-time incremental updates for new SKUs (~500\u20131k vectors/day).
- Reranker: currently a small transformer model run in CPU-hosted infra for A/B experiments.

Patterns & constraints
- Traffic: peak traffic 3\u20134 PM PST; query volume ~2M queries/day with 60% from search flows.
- Batch behavior: large nightly batch updates, occasional bulk imports (catalog refreshes) and steady low-volume incremental updates.
- Cost sensitivity: upper bound target for inference layer is roughly $X per 100k queries (we noted you said cost is a constraint; we\u2019ll refine numbers in follow-up).

Our proposal (next steps)
1) Tech deep dive (90 min) \u2014 include your Eng lead + our ML infra and runtime engineers to validate latency path, batching, and KV cache options.
2) Pilot scope: 4-week pilot focusing on rerank for top-100k SKUs and A/Bing against current rule-based reranker.
3) Deliverables: pilot performance report (latency, cost, quality metrics), mapping to production-runbook and rollout plan.

Action items
- Emma: confirm participants for the tech deep dive and share any perf traces / current logs you can (esp. Pinecone query latency and nightly ingest metrics).
- BrightCart procurement: if you want, we can share a standard pilot SOW and NDA draft ahead of the deep dive.

Attachments: redwood-brightcart-MAP.xlsx (pilot milestone & success metrics), pilot-scope-statement.pdf

Thanks \u001F I\u2019ll follow up with some proposed times after I hear on availability.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Emma Lin <emma.lin@brightcart.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap: BrightCart embeddings & reranking (index size, latency, next steps)

Thanks Marissa \u2014 this looks right. A few clarifications/additions from our side:
- Index size: we\u2019re at the upper end of your estimate today \u2014 ~12M vectors after last month\u2019s catalog expansion. Dim is 1536 as noted.
- Pinecone: we use the standard replica configuration; average query latency to Pinecone is ~20\u201330ms but our current CPU reranker is the bottleneck (adds ~90\u2013110ms). End-to-end p95 is ~120ms today for our production rerank path.
- Traffic pattern: daily peak is closer to 2.5M queries on promo days; baseline normal is ~1.2\u20131.6M.
- Quality targets: we want >10% uplift in add-to-cart for search; for offline eval we\u2019ll expect to see +0.08 NDCG@10 to consider success.

We\u2019ll get you the Perf logs and Pinecone query traces ahead of the tech deep dive. For the deep dive attendees: please include someone from your runtime team who can talk about batching/continuous KV cache behavior and someone who can discuss quantized model options.

I\u2019ll confirm who from our Eng/ML team will join by end of day Friday.

\u001FEmma

Sounds good \u2014 I\u2019ve started a draft SOW and attached the MAP. Key items I included:
- Pilot scope: rerank for top 100k SKUs, 4-week run, A/B evaluation with tracking of add-to-cart and NDCG@10.
- Success metrics: +10% add-to-cart OR +0.08 NDCG@10; p95 latency <= 100ms.
- Pilot infra: recommend using a quantized model profile for rerank (FP16 or 4-bit) and Redwood-managed inference for the pilot to hit latency targets.
- Pricing: pilot credit model with a cap; details in attachment.

Attachment: redwood-brightcart-MAP.xlsx

I\u2019ll be ready to send the SOW to procurement once Emma confirms the deep dive time and provides the perf traces.
